# Clouds provenance

Cirrus is a fixed-point reimplementation of the Clouds DSP from
[pichenettes/eurorack](https://github.com/pichenettes/eurorack) at
`f4cfa7697095a28d292bff758beb51deb49b5a86` (stmlib at
`d18def816c51d1da0c108236928b2bbd25c17481`), MIT, copyright Emilie Gillet
([LICENSE](LICENSE)). Clouds computes in floating point, which the OP-XY's
Blackfin does not have, so no upstream file is vendored verbatim: each Cirrus
file follows the upstream code it names, formula for formula.

| Cirrus | Upstream |
| --- | --- |
| [granular.h](../granular.h) | `clouds/dsp/granular_sample_player.h` (`Play`, `ScheduleGrain`), `grain.h` (`Start`, `RenderEnvelope`, `OverlapAdd`), `audio_buffer.h` (16-bit `ReadLinear`, `ReadHermite`), the granular part of `granular_processor.cc` (`ProcessGranular`, `Prepare`, the output's `SoftConvert`), `cv_scaler.cc` (Pitch), stmlib `Random` and `SemitonesToRatio` |
| [core.h](../core.h) | The state of `GranularSamplePlayer` and its grains at the 16-bit qualities |
| [sample.cpp](../sample.cpp) | `GranularSamplePlayer::Init`, and the codec's 16-bit output |
| [tables.h](../tables.h) | `clouds/resources/lookup_tables.py`, regenerated by the repository's `tools/clouds_tables.py` |
| [fixed.h](../fixed.h) | stmlib `SoftLimit`, `Random` and `SemitonesToRatio` |
